title: hypericum tomentosum subsp. lusitanicum
intro: Hypericum tomentosum subsp. lusitanicum, commonly known as the Lusitanian St. John's Wort, is a species of flowering plant in the St. John's Wort family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include the ability to reduce anxiety and depression by promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Lusitanian St. John's Wort include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and phytosterols. The bioactive constituents in Lusitanian St. John's Wort, including hyperforin and hypericin, have been found to have antioxidant and photoprotective effects, making it a potential remedy for various skin conditions and wounds.
